Machines.Name: Four-step closed walk
Machines.Preserves: Ordered handoffs; closing return; opposing reaches share roles.
Machines.Changes: Width and height vary independently. A notch needs extra phases.

Machines.Name: Two pairs of rails
Machines.Preserves: Shared intersections; parallel pairs; common width and height.
Machines.Changes: Aspect changes directly. Concavity needs a different boundary construction.

Machines.Name: Four equal radial turns
Machines.Preserves: Common contour; cyclic adjacency; equal-turn promise; equal component reaches.
Machines.Changes: Uniform scaling fits. Stretching needs release of equal-turn calibration.

Machines.Name: Four radial points, angular gaps open
Machines.Preserves: Common contour and cyclic adjacency remain; equal-turn obligation stays open.
Machines.Changes: Rectangles fit the supplied centered realization; general radial interpolation remains open.

Machines.Name: Two opposed caps
Machines.Preserves: Two three-phase routes share their authored start and end sites.
Machines.Changes: Same rectangle outline; different section count and traversal.

Machines.Name: Six-step notched walk
Machines.Preserves: Ordered return survives the inserted left/up detour.
Machines.Changes: A zero-at-resolution notch retains two phases. Increasing its binding exposes concavity.

Machines.Name: Three-step open walk
Machines.Preserves: Order and shared adjacent sites; no return edge is supplied.
Machines.Changes: Closing it requires adding the missing connection.

Machines.Name: Four detached rails
Machines.Preserves: Matching coordinate expressions, but independent endpoint identities.
Machines.Changes: The outline can agree with a loop. Joining requires explicit topology.
